up: Retrieve canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values (standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units) for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4495582'. Use the activities table joined with assays on assay_id, molecule_dictionary on molregno, and compound_structures on molregno. Return each activity record separately. Do not add any extra filters.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities act ON ass.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4495582';
